text:
riley: quick sanity check: playing with a timeline collapse pattern so long histories don't overwhelm the rollout canvas. idea: collapse older contiguous versions into a single "snapshot" chip that expands on click to reveal the mini-diff.

nina: i like collapsing. question: how do we indicate there's hidden context? need a clear affordance like a chevron + count ("+8").

omar: engineering note: expanding should fetch the mini-diffs lazily, we can't preload large histories for every tenant. expansion should be fast (<200ms).

elaine: a11y: snapshot chip must be keyboard-expandable and expose an accessible name like "Snapshot: 8 versions, collapsed". when expanded, focus should move to the first version chip inside.

riley: copy variants for collapsed chip: 1) "Snapshot • 8" 2) "8 versions collapsed" 3) "History (8)". which is clearest?

sam: prefer "8 versions" with a subtle label "collapsed" in the aria description for SR. visually shorter is better.

nina: visual hint: show the most recent child version as an overlapping mini-chip peeking out of the snapshot to give context. ensures users know what's under the hood.

omar: performance corner: if a snapshot includes an active canary, we should keep that canary visible and mark the rest collapsed. collapsing shouldn't hide in-progress rollouts.

elaine: SR announcements: when a snapshot auto-collapses after inactivity, announce politely: "Timeline collapsed to Snapshot of 6 versions". use polite live region.

riley: interactions: double-click on a chip should quick-expand inline; single click opens the detailed side panel. keyboard Enter toggles expand inline. Escape collapses.

sam: microcopy for the snapshot expanded header: "Snapshot: 8 versions (Jan 38 Jan 21)" subtitle: "Includes minor config updates and 1 canary". body lines are short bullets.

nina: footer helper copy under timeline: "Tip: collapse timelines to reduce noise. Click a snapshot to inspect small diffs." add a 'Learn more' doc link.

omar: rollback UX: when user triggers a rollback from inside an expanded snapshot, clarify scope: are we reverting a single version or the snapshot range? need explicit language.

elaine: propose two CTAs in the snapshot context: primary = "Pause rollout" (affects active canary only), secondary = "Revert range" (reverts all versions in snapshot). confirmation modal must list versions affected. SR text must be explicit: "Reverting will restore traffic to v9 and remove versions v10-v16."

riley: modal copy idea: header "Confirm revert of 7 versions?" body: "This will revert the selected range and route traffic back to v9. Audit record will include your name and reason." buttons: "Revert these versions" (danger) and "Cancel". add optional reason textarea.

sam: prefer including a small inline diff summary in the modal to avoid surprises. show 2-3 most impactful changes. keep it collapsed by default, expandable for long diffs.

nina: a11y for modal: trap focus correctly, ensure SR reads the summary then focus moves to the reason field if present. also provide a non-visual link "View full audit" for keyboard users.

omar: infra: we can attach an automatic snapshot id to audit trail. also support a dry-run toggle in modal that simulates revert checks and warns about dependent routes.

riley: copy for dry-run toggle tooltip: "Dry run: preview potential effects without changing traffic."

sam: visuals: snapshots should have a faint border and a stacked z-index for the peek, 40px min height. mobile: collapsed snapshot becomes a single full-width row with a chevron to expand.

nina: don't hide timestamps visually in collapsed mode; show a condensed date range instead for SR parity. keep the actual timestamps in visually-hidden spans for screen readers.

ux-bot: uploaded mock 1 https://img.redwood/snapshots/timeline-snapshot-proposal.png

riley: next steps: nina add SR strings for chip, expand, collapse, modals. sam mock the modal diff summary states. omar wire up lazy-load contract and dry-run flag. aiming for review in next design pass.

elaine: will write the modal confirmation SR text and a11y checklist.

riley: thanks team 44d locking thread until mocks land.
